verdict.rationale: Ramp's Treasury and Bill Pay docs mention 'unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments' and monetary-value schemas that support ISO 4217 currencies (USD, EUR, JPY) plus stablecoin payments, suggesting some cross-border payment capability, but there is no explicit documentation of paying vendors in their local currency, no FX-rate disclosure, and no stated fee schedule for international transfers beyond 'free wires.' missing for 10: explicit local-currency payout support, FX rate/fee transparency documentation, and independent verification of international payment costs.
